title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Alludu Adhurs
desc: A young man named Sreenu swears off women following a failed relationship. However, he falls in love with a gangster's daughter and is even forced to compete with another man for her hand in marriage.

title: Gopi Kishan
desc: Policeman Gopi's doppelgänger Kishan, who is a criminal, learns about the former and uses his identity to his advantage as he tries to find his father. This results in Gopi reaping the benefits.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

title: Game Changer
desc: A principled IAS officer battles systemic corruption, championing fair elections to uphold democratic integrity amidst political machinations.
